body:
**[critical · security] IDOR fix depends on an admin-api behavior this PR never shows**
The only enforcement here is hiding the Edit button by role. The comments say admin-api returns 403 and writes open_dist.sales_order_field_update_audit, but no admin-api change or link is included. If that is not already live, any Firebase-token holder can still PATCH any order's costs and seating.
- Fix: Link the admin-api commit or PR that enforces the edit-role 403 and persists the audit row, or keep ENG-2274 open until it lands.
- Cost: Needs a cross-repo check; no code change in this repo.

<!-- nrd-sight-finding:f06a205a-901c-4172-b86c-27e6f160a7b3 -->

**[important · reliability] Audit insert failure returns 500 after the write has committed**
The 'allowed' audit runs after the update, so an insert failure gives the client a 500 for an edit that was already saved. Users retry, and the docstring's claim that the edit is 'not reported as saved' is misleading.
- Fix: Write the audit row in the same DB transaction as the update, or insert the 'allowed' row before the write and fail closed there.
- Cost: A same-transaction write means changing the update_db functions to accept a connection.

<!-- nrd-sight-finding:0cddd2be-9e6b-4803-b9f6-06175bb52710 -->

**[consider · reliability] Migration for open_dist.sales_order_field_update_audit not visible**
The insert targets a new table, but no DDL is in the changed files. If the table is missing at deploy, every allowed edit commits and then returns 500.
- Fix: Add the migration to this PR, or confirm the table exists in the schema-owning repo before deploying.

<!-- nrd-sight-finding:12a3c22a-7cde-4b80-8d06-e964a5d27f92 -->

**[important · security] Audit omits cost fields on legacy-shape writes**
`_changed_field_names` only reads `purchases[*]` and section/row/seat_*. A legacy flattened PATCH (no `purchases`) writes `total_cost`, `api_cost`, currencies and `outbox_order_numbers`, but the audit row shows empty or seating-only `changed_fields`.
- Fix: When `body.purchases is None`, add `total_cost`, `currency_code`, `api_cost`, `api_cost_currency` and `outbox_order_numbers` from `body.model_fields_set` to the returned names, and add a legacy-shape audit test.
- Cost: Small code change; no schema impact.

<!-- nrd-sight-finding:13526a37-5a67-40f3-9936-22757bc69f8c -->

**[consider · reliability] Audit table DDL not in this PR; deploy order matters**
Every allowed edit now inserts into `open_dist.sales_order_field_update_audit` inside the edit transaction. If the table or trigger isn't live before this deploys, every allowed PATCH returns 500 and rolls back.
- Fix: Confirm the migration is applied in each environment before this deploys, or link the migration PR and state the order in the description.
- Cost: Costs only release coordination.

<!-- nrd-sight-finding:f37b2008-7aa8-4e8d-bde7-7893569e0fd3 -->

**[important · ownership] PR description and test plan describe behavior the code no longer has**
The description says the client loads roles from the ID token and GET /users/roles, loads the order, returns 403 without sending the PATCH, and audits successful edits. None of that exists now, and salesOrdersApi.authz.test.ts asserts the opposite (no `get`, no `getUserRoles`, no `console.info`).
- Fix: Rewrite the description and test plan to say this PR only hides the editor by role and sends a plain body, link admin-api-python#427 as the enforcement, and drop the test-plan items that no longer apply.
- Cost: Description edit only.

<!-- nrd-sight-finding:72041978-f3ef-44d3-b325-781dd5d75fcd -->

**[important · ownership] PR description and test plan describe behavior this diff removed**
The description says the client loads roles from the ID token and GET /users/roles, fetches the order, refuses with 403 before the PATCH, and audits successful edits. The code does none of that, and salesOrdersApi.authz.test.ts asserts the opposite (no get, no getUserRoles, no console.info).
- Fix: Rewrite the summary and test plan to say the client hides the editor by role and sends a plain body. Link the opendistribution-api/admin-api change that enforces the 403, the edit-grant rule and the audit row, and drop the client-side test-plan items.
- Cost: Description edit only; the linked backend PR is what ENG-2274 closure should depend on.

<!-- nrd-sight-finding:860e4ea4-fc25-465b-8032-ad02ed1976dd -->

**[consider · correctness] Own-listing exclusion depends on change history covering every created listing**
cheapest_non_od only excludes ids present in od_stubhub_change_history. If that table does not log every OD listing creation, OD's own listings appear as market comps and od_winning is understated.
- Fix: Verify od_stubhub_change_history has a row for every create action, and add a check that the historic id set covers all OD listing ids in the import history.
- Cost: Verification only if the table is complete; otherwise an upstream logging fix is needed.

<!-- nrd-sight-finding:0c581aa3-9670-4529-ac54-03a32064eb0a -->

**[important · correctness] Settle guard checks rows, not sessions, so a session still landing can be picked**
The 10-minute filter applies per row in the session pick, but od_market_data then reads every row of the chosen session, including rows still arriving. A session whose first rows are older than 10 minutes can win while later files are still loading, so the hourly snapshot is partial.
- Fix: Gate on session completion: group by event_id, collection_session_ts with having max(updated_at) < sysdate() - interval '10 minutes', then take the max session from that set.
- Cost: A new session becomes visible up to 10 minutes after its last row, and the previous complete session stays in use until then.

<!-- nrd-sight-finding:566ad562-54d3-4eb1-9642-e05f025ac55c -->

**[consider · architecture] Comp reader points at a table this change stops writing**
Nothing in the handler inserts into stubhub_listing_collection anymore, so load_latest_market_comps only sees pre-cutover rows. With the 12h cutoff it returns no comps, so choose_sell_price has no input and the auto-pricing goal is inert until a Snowflake reader exists.
- Fix: Point the comp read at OD_STUBHUB_AUTOPRICING_ALG2_V before wiring choose_sell_price, or mark the Postgres reader as unused in code so no caller assumes it works.
- Cost: A Snowflake read path adds a cross-system dependency and its own freshness rules.

<!-- nrd-sight-finding:9e6bbe02-a27d-475d-ad77-9f9da428e088 -->

**[consider · correctness] source column is exposed but never filtered in the comp view**
The view reads every row of the chosen session regardless of source. If the OD Lambda writes rows from more than one source, they are mixed into one comp set.
- Fix: Add a source filter to od_market_data (e.g. source = 'pos_listings_api') or document that the table carries only one source.
- Cost: If older records lack the source field, the filter drops them and comp coverage shrinks.

<!-- nrd-sight-finding:e46bf54b-421b-4094-b6a3-1cbb021b6656 -->

**[consider · performance] Hourly task scans the full 90-day listing history twice to find the latest session**
active_collection_per_event groups the whole 90-day window of the VARIANT-parsing view, and od_market_data reads it again, on every hourly run. Only the newest settled session per event is needed.
- Fix: Bound both reads to a recent updated_at window (for example sysdate() minus 2 days) so the hourly task does not reparse 90 days of history.
- Cost: A window shorter than the longest collection gap drops events from the comps, so size it above the max session interval.

_Fixed it? Push the fix and NRD Sight checks the next commit. Not a real problem? Reply with why, or resolve this conversation._

<!-- nrd-sight-finding:a68a11ef-322b-43f3-a76f-0245fc279377 -->

**[important · reliability] _dt snapshot has no 12-hour staleness guard**
The 12-hour cutoff exists only in the live view, so a suspended or failing hourly task leaves _dt holding old-session comps with no time filter. Lines 10-11 say the event must drop out rather than serve stale comps as current, and _dt does not do that.
- Fix: Add `collection_session_ts >= sysdate() - interval '12 hours'` to every read of _dt, or have the procedure delete rows older than 12 hours and alert when the task's last successful run is stale.
- Cost: An extra predicate on each read, or a task-failure monitor to set up.

_Fixed it? Push the fix and NRD Sight checks the next commit. Not a real problem? Reply with why, or resolve this conversation._

<!-- nrd-sight-finding:eb098ee3-5f4e-4df5-8693-9a391e7a2bcc -->

**[consider · security] Verify the new route key has role rows, or the page opens to every signed-in user**
RequireAuth with routeKeys resolves through role_menu_items; per the comment in maintenancePermissions.ts, a key with no rows yields an empty list, which RequireAuth grants. A new key with no seeded rows would expose the Listing Issues page and its re-sync actions to all authenticated users.
- Fix: Confirm role_menu_items has rows for open-distribution-listing-issues (od_admin, inventory_ops, od_sales_editor) before merging, or guard the route with explicit requiredRoles.
- Cost: Explicit requiredRoles duplicates the role list in code, but removes the dependency on seeded DB rows.

_Fixed it? Push the fix and NRD Sight checks the next commit. Not a real problem? Reply with why, or resolve this conversation._

<!-- nrd-sight-finding:76f113a3-18ab-4d3f-8191-f4e6c75b7764 -->

**[important · correctness] Stale/Missing KPI click lands on an empty queue when a session is selected**
handlePosMetricClick scopes to the currently selected session, so if that session has zero of the metric the KPI total (global) shows a queue with no rows and no explanation.
- Fix: For KPI clicks, always pick firstSessionWith(summary, metric) (or keep the selection only when it has a non-zero count for that metric).
- Cost: Operators lose the 'stay on my session' behaviour when clicking a global KPI; a one-line change.

_Fixed it? Push the fix and NRD Sight checks the next commit. Not a real problem? Reply with why, or resolve this conversation._

<!-- nrd-sight-finding:177a7927-41d0-47eb-9145-e5e2e324082a -->

**[consider · correctness] Drawer holds a row snapshot that goes stale after Refresh**
drawerRow stores a copy of the listing, so Refresh updates the queue and eventQuery but the open drawer keeps the old diagnosis, quantities and raw error, and Copy Error Payload copies that stale data.
- Fix: Store only the selected listing_id and derive the row from eventQuery.data.listings on each render.
- Cost: Drawer closes if the listing disappears on refetch, which needs a null check; small change.

_Fixed it? Push the fix and NRD Sight checks the next commit. Not a real problem? Reply with why, or resolve this conversation._

<!-- nrd-sight-finding:9dd4cfa0-4d1d-4480-ae56-a45d03fbeb23 -->

**[important · correctness] Orphan POS rows duplicate across Outbox events that share a StubHub event**
The orphan branch joins POS rows to each event by stubhub_event_id, but the NOT EXISTS only checks that event's own internal listings. A POS listing matched in Outbox event A is emitted again as an orphan under event B, inflating stale_in_pos, stale_excess_tickets and total_listings in the KPIs.
- Fix: Make the orphan NOT EXISTS check internal listings across all events with the same stubhub_event_id, or emit orphans once per stubhub_event_id.
- Cost: Slightly heavier anti-join; alternatively enforce one Outbox event per StubHub event in sync config.

_Fixed it? Push the fix and NRD Sight checks the next commit. Not a real problem? Reply with why, or resolve this conversation._

<!-- nrd-sight-finding:5bc3c9a8-9ce4-429c-b486-c591190d16cb -->

**[consider · correctness] Dashboard role set excludes roles named in the acceptance criteria**
The ticket lists od_sales_editor (and inventory_ops) as authorized business roles, but the route uses OD_READ_ROLES and a test pins od_sales_editor to 403. This is either an unmade decision or a gap against the AC.
- Fix: Confirm with the ticket owner whether od_sales_editor should read listing issues; if yes, add it to a dashboard-specific role set and flip the test.
- Cost: Widening access exposes StubHub listing data to another role group.

_Fixed it? Push the fix and NRD Sight checks the next commit. Not a real problem? Reply with why, or resolve this conversation._

<!-- nrd-sight-finding:f4c12a02-3688-4784-bea4-782715bf9a2d -->

**[important · correctness] Stale POS matrix cell shows listing count, not excess tickets**
The Stale POS column displays stale_in_pos (listing count); the excess tickets appear only in a tooltip. The ticket asks that this column sum the quantity mismatches and that stale rows surface the delta, so operators cannot see the total over-sold quantity from the matrix.
- Fix: Display counts.stale_excess_tickets as the cell value (e.g. "+7 tickets") and keep the listing count in the click label and tooltip.
- Cost: The column meaning changes, so the header and the KPI tile wording need to be updated together.

_Fixed it? Push the fix and NRD Sight checks the next commit. Not a real problem? Reply with why, or resolve this conversation._

<!-- nrd-sight-finding:8d452c97-27c3-4307-995c-6ac23242db84 -->

**[important · correctness] Stale listings get the StubHub error diagnosis instead of the quantity delta**
Raw-error refinement runs before the POS-stale branch, so a listing that is stale in POS but carries an old INVALID_SECTION or barcode error is labelled Unmapped Section or Barcode Collision. The excess-quantity guidance is lost, and telemetry top_error counts it under the wrong label.
- Fix: Return _stale() before the raw-code checks, and apply raw-error refinement only to POS_NOT_RECEIVED and SH_NOT_RECEIVED.
- Cost: Needs a regression test for stale rows with a raw INVALID_SECTION error.

_Fixed it? Push the fix and NRD Sight checks the next commit. Not a real problem? Reply with why, or resolve this conversation._

<!-- nrd-sight-finding:fd12db6e-7750-4a97-a657-b45356de121b -->

**[important · reliability] Timed-out Snowflake threads keep running on the shared default executor**
_within_budget cancels the await but not the worker thread, and the degraded summary TTL is 10 s, so each rebuild queues up to ~6 new threads while earlier ones are still blocked for the 20 s query timeout. A hung Snowflake can exhaust the default executor that other asyncio.to_thread callers in this service also use.
- Fix: Run Snowflake reads on a dedicated bounded ThreadPoolExecutor (about 4 workers) so a hang cannot starve other to_thread callers, and skip new Snowflake loads while the previous one for that key is still in flight.
- Cost: Extra executor to own; requests that need Snowflake can queue behind the bounded pool when it is saturated.

_Fixed it? Push the fix and NRD Sight checks the next commit. Not a real problem? Reply with why, or resolve this conversation._

<!-- nrd-sight-finding:efbec690-023c-4ccd-b164-ea90847712ab -->

**[consider · cost] Unscoped MAX(INSERTDATE) scan on every summary cache miss**
_load_freshness runs SELECT MAX(INSERTDATE) over the whole share table on each summary build, once per filter key every 60 s (10 s when degraded). The result is global, not per key, so filtered views multiply the warehouse cost.
- Fix: Load freshness once per process on its own TTL, outside the per-key build, and reuse it across summary keys.
- Cost: The freshness timestamp can be up to its TTL older than the rest of the summary.

_Fixed it? Push the fix and NRD Sight checks the next commit. Not a real problem? Reply with why, or resolve this conversation._

<!-- nrd-sight-finding:df068ea4-d7b8-4270-a8cb-c03a8444da7a -->

**[consider · correctness] Matrix does not auto-collapse on drill-down, as the acceptance criteria require**
OPE-352 requires clicking a non-zero shortfall or stale cell, or a session row, to collapse the matrix and scroll to the queue. openQueue only sets the selection and scrolls, so the matrix stays expanded and the queue is pushed further down.
- Fix: Call setIsMatrixCollapsed(true) inside openQueue so every drill-down collapses the matrix; Alt+O still reopens it.
- Cost: Users lose matrix context until they press Alt+O or Expand, which the goal accepts.

_Fixed it? Push the fix and NRD Sight checks the next commit. Not a real problem? Reply with why, or resolve this conversation._

<!-- nrd-sight-finding:9445b52e-7ecd-43eb-a7c7-2105584179b8 -->

**[consider · reliability] Empty comps may reprice auto-priced listings to the markup default with no alert**
With no API snapshot in 12 h, the query returns no rows. The PR says the listing price stays unchanged, but the enqueued price is whatever the non-auto sync computes, so the next update may push the markup price over the last auto price. A collection outage, the same failure that broke this, would then reprice every auto-priced event at the 12 h ma…
- Fix: Verify in auto_pricing_service and the update diff that an empty comp set keeps the last auto price; if it does not, skip repricing for that event and emit a metric or alert when an auto-priced event has zero comps.
- Cost: Holding the last auto price means a stale price can persist until data returns, and the alert needs a metric and an on-call route.

_Fixed it? Push the fix and NRD Sight checks the next commit. Not a real problem? Reply with why, or resolve this conversation._

<!-- nrd-sight-finding:d31ea3dd-276e-48ee-afe2-dc43d38f7f09 -->

**[consider · correctness] Currency pick counts OD listings that the view then drops**
group_currency counts OD listings, but the final select excludes them, so the stated rule (count only rows the output can use) is broken. A group where OD listings outnumber comps in another currency gets an empty comp set for that row.
- Fix: Add the is_od_listing and historic-backstop exclusion to group_currency's inner query, or document that OD listings intentionally vote on currency.
- Cost: Adds the OD backstop join into the currency pick, so this view diverges further from alg2.

_Fixed it? Push the fix and NRD Sight checks the next commit. Not a real problem? Reply with why, or resolve this conversation._

<!-- nrd-sight-finding:71c2a046-a83c-499e-9dd5-13986492b879 -->

**[consider · reliability] Comp outage also freezes inventory changes on auto-priced listings**
The merge drops every UPDATE/TRANSFER row for an auto candidate, not just price-diff rows, so quantity and seat changes stop syncing; sold seats can stay live on the exchange until comps return.
- Fix: Keep the UPDATE row for auto candidates but pin its price to the held value (outbox_price / source_price) instead of dropping it.
- Cost: Requires carrying the held price through both merges and the message; more change than the current drop-all approach.

_Fixed it? Push the fix and NRD Sight checks the next commit. Not a real problem? Reply with why, or resolve this conversation._

<!-- nrd-sight-finding:f68bc627-0f71-4c02-9900-0b9f27836ec1 -->

**[important · correctness] Refetch with changed counts resets every show's session page**
The matrix resets pages whenever the shows array reference changes. TanStack structural sharing only keeps summary.shows when every show is unchanged, so any count change on a focus or Refresh refetch sends all shows back to page 1. The spec says a refetch that returns the same shows keeps each show's page.
- Fix: Derive the reset key from the show ids (and each show's session ids) instead of array identity, so count-only changes keep pages while filter or membership changes still reset.
- Cost: Adds a small signature helper and a comparison in pagesForShows; the existing identity-based tests need updating.

_Fixed it? Push the fix and NRD Sight checks the next commit. Not a real problem? Reply with why, or resolve this conversation._

<!-- nrd-sight-finding:2d5426ac-ca06-4809-909e-acdc1a82bb29 -->

**[consider · correctness] Collapsing the matrix discards every show's session page**
IssuesMatrix unmounts when the card collapses, so its page state and shared page size are lost. Expanding again shows page 1 everywhere, against the 'each show keeps its own page' requirement.
- Fix: Render IssuesMatrix unconditionally and rely on the existing `hidden` attribute on the region, or lift the page state up to ListingIssues.
- Cost: The table stays mounted while collapsed, which costs some render work on each summary update.

_Fixed it? Push the fix and NRD Sight checks the next commit. Not a real problem? Reply with why, or resolve this conversation._

<!-- nrd-sight-finding:eea624a3-975b-485c-a2de-4b2e1419a1e4 -->

**[consider · performance] Share index built synchronously on the event loop**
build_share_index runs on the loop after the Snowflake await, creating ~130k ShareRow objects and two dict maps per cache miss. That stalls every other request in the admin API process for the build duration, once per account set per 60 s.
- Fix: Build the index off-loop with asyncio.to_thread(build_share_index, rows) in _load_share, and measure build wall time on a 130k-row fixture.
- Cost: Adds a thread hop and copies the rows across threads; the cache and TTL logic stay unchanged.

_Fixed it? Push the fix and NRD Sight checks the next commit. Not a real problem? Reply with why, or resolve this conversation._

<!-- nrd-sight-finding:7418b5be-9565-4a4e-bbb8-bbe84595e320 -->

**[important · reliability] Check constraint validation scans the whole table under ACCESS EXCLUSIVE**
Adding a CHECK constraint in the same ALTER TABLE validates every existing row while holding ACCESS EXCLUSIVE, blocking reads and writes on stubhub_listing_collection for the scan. Flyway runs the file in one transaction, so the lock lasts until commit and scan time grows with table size.
- Fix: Add the column and the constraint as NOT VALID in this migration, then run VALIDATE CONSTRAINT slc_source_check in a separate migration file so it takes only SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE.
- Cost: Two migration files instead of one; the constraint is enforced for new rows immediately either way.

_Fixed it? Push the fix and NRD Sight checks the next commit. Not a real problem? Reply with why, or resolve this conversation._

<!-- nrd-sight-finding:4fbfd22c-6eb1-498d-b7b2-4ede95dde958 -->

**[consider · correctness] TB POS is not held during comp outages**
The README states TB POS is not held and that auto pricing applies first in the TB POS builder. With no comps, the desired-state upsert would reprice live TB POS listings to the markup price, the same failure this PR fixes for StubHub and TradeDesk.
- Fix: Confirm tbpos listing_builder skips auto pricing when there are no market rows, or hold TB POS upserts for auto-priced listings the way the UPDATE path does.
- Cost: Adds hold logic to a third marketplace path that is outside this diff.

_Fixed it? Push the fix and NRD Sight checks the next commit. Not a real problem? Reply with why, or resolve this conversation._

<!-- nrd-sight-finding:f78ad768-f86b-4c0b-9a24-22acaae3da3d -->
